name: GIRL is SIGNAL
source:
In Traum, the City of History, not everything is what it seems. Noah, an ordinary computer science student, encounters a strange signal when he messes around with equipment in his radio club. As he searches for a way to get rid of interference, how far will he go? More importantly, how does he keep getting away with all of this?

[From [url=https://dollhousing.itch.io/girl-is-signal]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在历史之城特劳姆，并非一切都如表面所见。普通计算机系大学生诺亚在无线电社团摆弄器材时，无意间截获了一道诡异的信号。为了消除信号干扰，他究竟会做到何种地步？更重要的是，他为何总能在闯下这一切之后全身而退？

[摘自[url=https://dollhousing.itch.io/girl-is-signal]itch.io[/url]]
